requirements: 100 SDK strategy processes, 10 synthetic account-owner services, one shared market service and one Monitor service; report process topology and slow-consumer/reconnect behavior.
U0 baseline: 20 public topics, 200 inputs/second, approximately 256 bytes per input, 20,000 strategy deliveries/second, 30 minutes, and two logical account order cycles/second/account.

Register each workload separately for overlap, same-symbol/different-market, multi-timeframe, hot-account/hot-contract, multiple-account, multi-contract and grouped-order behavior; include slow-consumer, reconnect and query-throttle scope with per-profile input/distribution/group ratio/thresholds.

Report throughput, end-to-end p50/p95/p99, request timeouts, sequence gaps and recovery time, CPU/memory, queue/disk watermarks and post-close resources; enforce no silent critical loss, cross-account leakage or duplicate/unknown dispatch.

latency.rpc_percentile_scope: Report p50/p95/p99 for every required strategy-operation stratum. p50 and p95 are observations only; preserve the 5,000 ms per-call timeout, zero-timeout gate, and p99 ceiling. This is not a low-latency or HFT acceptance claim.
latency.market_percentile_scope: Report p50/p95/p99 as required finite observations for every strategy. These values are not a latency gate and do not claim low-latency or HFT acceptance.
latency.outcome_classification: The future runner caller must classify each observed response or exception as success, error, or timeout; the collector validates the supplied category and does not infer it.

N5.group_metrics: Use the separate N5 group and child-dispatch dimensions; do not infer their latency threshold from ordinary RPC targets.

latency.aggregation: Report counts and nearest-rank latency for each strategy and operation; evaluate every required strategy-operation stratum against these targets. Operation-presence coverage requires each registered operation to be observed at least once per strategy, while workload-volume completeness is checked against the registered profile target counts. Also report total counts by operation. Do not pool per-strategy bounded samples as if they were one uniform population.
latency.sampling: A deterministic bounded reservoir may estimate percentiles; report total observations, retained sample count, capacity, coverage fraction, and whether the full population was retained. Never label sampled estimates as a full-population distribution.
